entities.summary: Eugenia Crușevan was the first female lawyer in Bessarabia (1918). She begun her lawyer career by signing up in the bar of lawyers in Chișinău. In the early 1950s, she moved to Timișoara. She practised law until retirement.

entities.summary: Eugenia Crușevan was the first female lawyer in Bessarabia (1918). She begun her lawyer career by signing up in the bar of lawyers in Chișinău. In the early 1950s, she moved to Timișoara. She practised law until retirement.
